description.en: Per-session permission grants: enable workspace-write, full access or no-approval for chosen sessions while staying a no-op everywhere else; includes path fallback and approval policy. Keywords: permission, approval, sandbox, full access. MIT.
description.zh: 按会话下发权限：给指定会话开工作区写 / 全盘 / 免审批，其余会话默认空转不放权；带路径回退与审批策略。关键词：权限 permission、审批 approval、沙箱 sandbox、full access。MIT。
